title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Manlabang in the Municipality of Caibiran, Subprovince of Biliran, Province of Leyte
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Manlabang in the Municipality of Caibiran, Subprovince of Biliran, Province of Leyte
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Barrio Manlabang tại Đô thị Caibiran, Tiểu tỉnh Biliran, Tỉnh Leyte
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งบาริโอ Manlabang ในเทศบาล Caibiran กิ่งจังหวัด Biliran จังหวัด Leyte
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Barrio Manlabang di Kotamadya Caibiran, Subprovinsi Biliran, Provinsi Leyte
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Barrio Manlabang di Perbandaran Caibiran, Subwilayah Biliran, Wilayah Leyte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3374_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Manlabang, Jubasan, Balilid and Toril in the Municipality of Caibiran, Sub-province of Biliran, Province of Leyte, are constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Manlabang.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
